According to the datasheet, the Fisher ET is a **single-port, globe-style control valve with cage guiding, a balanced valve plug, and push-down-to-close valve plug action** [p. 3]. Details to note:

- **The valve family / related variants**: The bulletin actually covers three variants:

  - **EAT** – an angle version of the ET control valve, used to facilitate piping or where a self-draining valve is desired [p. 3]
  - **ETR** – same as ET but with push-down-to-open valve plug action [p. 3]

- **Valve sizes**: available from NPS 1 up to NPS 8 (NPS = nominal pipe size in inches). Weights range from about 14 kg (30 lb) for NPS 1 to about 408 kg (900 lb) for NPS 8 [p. 4].

- **Guiding / plug type**: all three designs use cage guiding, single ports, and balanced valve plugs [p. 2].

- **Seating**: metal-to-PTFE seating is standard in all valves except those with Cavitrol III cages (where metal-to-metal seating is standard, for higher temperatures); metal-to-metal seating is optional for all other valves [p. 2].
